Add one row per camera. Detection rules: Add one row per camera. Detection rules (line crossing, intrusion, ...) are configured in the camera itself; this adapter only listens. The camera user needs remote notification / alarm permission.
Name: Name
Clears an active alarm that the camera s: Clears an active alarm that the camera stops refreshing (cameras that never send inactive)
Reconnect when no data or heartbeat arri: Reconnect when no data or heartbeat arrives for this long (armed after the first data)
Normalized or raw names, e.g. motion,vmd: Normalized or raw names, e.g. motion,vmd

1. In the camera web UI, for every rule: 1. In the camera web UI, for every rule you want to receive (Event > Smart Event / Basic Event), open Linkage Method and tick 'Notify Surveillance Center'. Enabling a rule alone does not send it over ISAPI.
2. Create a camera user with remote noti: 2. Create a camera user with remote notification / alarm permission. Administrator rights are not needed.
3. Check access from the ioBroker host:: 3. Check access from the ioBroker host: curl --digest -N -u USER 'http://CAMERA_IP/ISAPI/Event/notification/alertStream' (curl asks for the password). Events and a heartbeat should appear.
The adapter is read-only: it never chang: The adapter is read-only: it never changes detection rules, schedules, linkage or network settings.
